items.definition:
relating to Honduras or its people
She enjoyed Honduran coffee.

Relating to Zambia or its people.
She met a Zambian student at the conference.

Relating to Zimbabwe or its people.
The Zimbabwean team played well in the tournament.

Excessively interested in other people's affairs
My neighbor is very nosy and always asks about my business.

Not invited.
An uninvited guest showed up at the party.

loose and flapping
The bird had small, flappy wings.

having a rough or granular texture
The old photograph looked grainy and faded.

Full of or covered with lumps.
The mashed potatoes were a bit lumpy.

full of or accompanied by tears
She had a teary look in her eyes after watching the sad movie.

not able to make decisions quickly and effectively
He's very indecisive and struggles to choose what to eat.

arriving or doing something at the agreed or proper time
It's important to be punctual for meetings.

easy to understand or do
The instructions were clear and uncomplicated.

sleepy and lethargic; half asleep
The medication made her feel very drowsy.

having or showing the symptoms of a fever; characterized by intense emotion or activity
The child felt feverish and had to stay home from school.

(of a drink) effervescent; bubbling
I prefer fizzy drinks over still water.

The last in a series of a million; one part of a million
He was the millionth customer to enter the store.

able to soak up liquid easily
Paper towels are very absorbent.

extending throughout a city
There was a citywide celebration after the team won the championship.

(of a letter) not a capital letter
Please write your name in lowercase letters.

not damaged or harmed
Despite the accident, the car remained largely undamaged.

like a boy
He still had a boyish charm despite his age.

rough, causing an itching sensation
This wool sweater feels very scratchy.

not fashionable or impressive
Wearing socks with sandals used to be considered uncool.

consisting of or resembling powder
The snow was light and powdery, perfect for skiing.

Unpleasant or sticky
The slime felt icky to the touch.

able to stretch or be stretched easily
These new jeans are really stretchy and comfortable.

consisting of or resembling a swamp; boggy
The ground was very swampy after the heavy rain.

weak; cowardly
Don't be so wimpy; stand up for yourself!

without bones
I prefer boneless chicken breasts for dinner.

liable to change
The weather in spring is very changeable.

Comfortable and cozy, like home.
The small cottage had a very homey atmosphere.

lasting over a long period of time
We need a long-term solution to this problem.

inspiring or deserving love or affection
The puppy was so lovable that everyone wanted to pet it.

able to be moved
The furniture was easily movable.

able to be returned for a refund
The ticket is refundable if you cancel within 24 hours.

providing rest and relaxation
The quiet countryside was very restful.

resembling or containing soap
The water felt soapy after I added the bath bomb.

having sharp points
The hedgehog had spiky quills.

not included in a list or directory
She has an unlisted phone number.

made of wool
She wore a warm woollen scarf.

not requiring physical contact
I prefer to use contactless payment methods.

having no cord; operating without a cord
She bought a new cordless vacuum cleaner.

unpleasant or offensive
He has a very disagreeable personality, which makes him difficult to work with.

not firm or stable; liable to fall or shake
He felt unsteady on his feet after the long illness.

unfashionable and socially awkward
He wore a dorky hat to the party.

without a goal being scored
The football match ended in a goalless draw.

made or caused by human beings, not by nature
The lake is a man-made reservoir.

characteristic of a mother, especially in being caring, protective, or nurturing
She had a very kind and motherly demeanor.

somewhat pink in color
The sky turned a beautiful pinkish hue at sunset.

relating to a view of what is behind
He checked his rearview mirror before changing lanes.

relating to Senegal or its people
The Senegalese team played well in the football match.

having no straps, especially to support a garment
She wore a beautiful strapless dress to the party.

relating to Tanzania or its people
She enjoyed listening to traditional Tanzanian music.

comfortably warm
The fire made the room feel wonderfully toasty.

not having been washed
Please put the unwashed clothes in the laundry basket.

covered with a bandage
His arm was heavily bandaged after the accident.

a pale purple color
She painted her room a soft mauve shade.

able to be reached
Make sure the emergency exit is easily reachable.

feeling no fear
She was unafraid to speak her mind.

made of wool
She wore a warm woolen scarf in the cold weather.

sparkling with small, bright flashes of light
The children loved the glittery decorations.

having a fresh, cool taste or smell like mint
The chewing gum had a strong, minty flavor.

covered with mold
We had to throw out the moldy bread.

extremely fast
We need a superfast internet connection for streaming.
